pages.text: Cursed honey is dropped by Possessed Bees. Eating it grants instant health and absorption effects.$(br)
Beaver Nuggets are filling snacks dispensed by an upgraded Beaver Familiar. Eating one restores 8 hunger points and has no additional effects.$(br)
Sweet honey heart is crafted from cursed honey and other ingredients. Provides strong healing effects.$(br)
Demonic meat is dropped by Possessed Zombified Piglins. Eating it grants strength and fire resistance.$(br)
